# ui::OsThemeSnapshot

Header: `winui/ui/themes/ThemeSource.hpp`.

The system's theme settings, before any app override is applied.

The library reads one from the system's settings. A default-constructed snapshot is light, with Windows' default blue accent and no high contrast, which resolves to the colors Windows 11 shows out of the box.

Example: 
```cpp
// Preview both modes side by side, whatever the OS is set to.
const ui::Theme light = ui::resolve_theme(ui::ThemeRequest{}, ui::OsThemeSnapshot{.dark = false});
const ui::Theme dark  = ui::resolve_theme(ui::ThemeRequest{}, ui::OsThemeSnapshot{.dark = true});

ui::Window light_preview{{.title = "Light"}};
ui::Window dark_preview{{.title = "Dark"}};
light_preview.pin_theme(light);
dark_preview.pin_theme(dark);
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dark` | `bool` | `false` | The system's app mode: true when "Choose your app mode" is set to Dark. |
| `accent` | `Color` | `Color::from_argb(0xFF0078D4)` | The user's accent color. |
| `accent_ramp` | `AccentRamp` |  | The system's lighter and darker shades of `accent`. The defaults are the shades of Windows' default blue. |
| `high_contrast` | `bool` | `false` | Whether a contrast theme is on. When true, [resolve_theme()](namespace-ui.md#resolve_theme) draws with `hc` whatever the [ThemeRequest](theme-request.md) says. |
| `hc` | `HighContrastPalette` |  | The contrast theme's colors. Only read while `high_contrast` is true. |
| `menu_animation` | `bool` | `true` | The system's menu animation setting. With `menu_fade` and `combo_box_animation`, it sets how popups open in the Luna and Aero themes ([`Theme::popup_motion`](theme.md#popup_motion)). All three are on by default. This one and `combo_box_animation` are off while the system turns UI effects off. |
| `menu_fade` | `bool` | `true` | See `menu_animation`: whether menus fade in (true) or slide in. |
| `combo_box_animation` | `bool` | `true` | See `menu_animation`: whether combo box drop-downs slide open. |
| `animations_enabled` | `bool` | `true` | The system's "Animation effects" setting. [ThemeRequest::animations](theme-request.md) follows it by default. |
| `transparency_enabled` | `bool` | `true` | Whether the system draws transparency: "Transparency effects" is on in Settings, and neither Energy Saver nor a remote session turns it off. Fluent 2's in-app acrylic ([Theme::overlay_material](theme.md#overlay_material)) follows it. |
| `system_variant` | `ThemeVariant` | `ThemeVariant::Fluent2` | What ThemeVariant::System draws: Fluent2 on Windows 11 (build 22000 and later), Fluent on any earlier Windows. |
